subject: POC inputs onboarding: prompt/log delivery & owners
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam Patel <liam.patel@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-12T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: POC inputs onboarding: prompt/log delivery & owners

Hi Liam —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned for the 2-week POC: 

Call recap / goals:
- Objective: validate Redwood inference latency/cost on typical Nimbus prompt workload and evaluate answer quality against your existing rule-based assistant.
- Success criteria (proposed):
  * Mean latency (p95) under 250ms for single-turn prompts at 8k token windows,
  * Accuracy uplift >= 15% on labeled eval set (we'll use your golden labels),
  * No PII leakage detected in automated checks; any flagged items must be remediated.

Files we need from your side (by EOD Thu, 2028-06-15):
- Prompt set: CSV with columns (prompt_id, prompt_text, context, expected_output_label) — ~10k rows ideal.
- Raw logs: anonymized request logs (timestamp, user_id_hash, prompt_text, model_response) — if you must, replace user_id with hashed id; we can accept presigned S3 or SFTP.
- A small labeled eval CSV (200-500 examples) to use as gold standard for initial quality checks.

Ownership (please confirm):
- Data transfer owner for Nimbus: Liam (you) — confirm whether security needs a DPA or approved S3 bucket.
- Redwood owners: Marissa Cole will lead evaluation and result reporting; Priyom Das will own data ingestion and redaction tooling.

Operational checklist (we'll complete on our side):
- Provide sample ingestion script and schema.
- Run automated PII redaction pass on your raw logs (we can do this if needed).
- Share HubSpot deal + any procurement contact if you need a PO for trial credits.

Attachments: sample CSV template attached for prompt set (prompt_sample_template.csv).

Please reply with preferred transfer method (presigned S3, secure Dropbox, or SFTP) and confirm owners/timeline. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Liam Patel <liam.patel@nimbus.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-12T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC inputs onboarding: prompt/log delivery & owners

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers: 

- Transfer: we can do presigned S3. Security needs the presign to expire in 24 hours for our workflow; if Redwood prefers longer-lived links we can scope with a short-lived role. Please confirm which you prefer.
- Files: we'll deliver a prompt CSV (~12k rows) + a zipped log export (redacted) and a 300-example labeled eval set.
- Success criteria: the latency & accuracy targets look fine — one modification: for p95 latency we need to see behavior at peak concurrency (we typically test with 6 concurrent users), can Redwood include a small load-run in the plan?

I'll attach a small sample so your ingestion team can sanity-check the schema.

Attachments: nimbus_sample_prompts.csv

Liam Patel
Product Manager, Nimbus Analytics
liam.patel@nimbus.ai | (650) 555-0199

On Tue, Jun 12, 2028 at 3:10 PM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Liam —
> 
> Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned for the 2-week POC: 
> ...
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam Patel <liam.patel@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-13T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC inputs onboarding: prompt/log delivery & owners

Thanks Liam — presigned S3 is preferred (short expiry is fine). We'll request 48-hour presigned URLs to make ingestion straightforward; if Nimbus needs 24 hours we can sequence pulls more tightly.

On the concurrency test: yes — we'll run a small synthetic load-run that mirrors 6 concurrent users hitting typical prompt distribution and report p50/p95 under that load. We'll include a tool + config so you can reproduce locally.

Confirming owners on our side: 
- Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com) — Eval lead: quality measurement, labeling reconciliation, report.
- Priyom Das (priyom.das@redwood.com) — Data ingestion & redaction: run PII checks, coordinate transfers, and validate schema.

Checklist for Nimbus to close out before we start ingestion:
- Deliver presigned S3 links for: prompt CSV, zipped logs export, labeled eval CSV (deadline: EOD Thu 2028-06-15).
- Confirm whether any fields must be redacted prior to transfer (PII policy).
- Share any rate limits we should apply during load-run to simulate production traffic.

We'll prepare an onboarding doc and a short runbook (ingestion commands + mapping) and share it to the HubSpot deal link. If all good, we can begin ingestion Friday morning once files arrive.

Ben
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-15T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Nimbus POC — files received and quick intake notes (internal)

Marissa / Priyom — quick internal note:
- Received from Nimbus at 08:50: presigned S3 links and two attachments (nimbus_sample_prompts.csv, nimbus_prompt_logs_export.zip).
- Quick inventory: ~12,200 prompt rows; logs zip contains ~150k request records. Logs include free-text user messages — apply redaction pipeline before we index.
- Action items: 
  1) Priyom: start ingestion on staging, run automated PII redaction, return a redaction report (due EOD today).
  2) Marissa: prepare initial eval harness using the 300 labeled examples; plan to compute baseline accuracy and collect 50 manual review samples.
  3) I'll schedule a 30-min sync at 11:00 to align on blockages and confirm the synthetic concurrency config.

Thanks — Ben
(end of thread)
